verdicts.rationale: cowleynoyearhigh and cowleynoyearadaptive have identical title, author, year, journal, volume, number, pages, and DOI. Duplicate imports under different hand keys.
crane2003 and crane2003mechanical are identical books (Crane, The Mechanical Mind, 2003, Routledge, same DOI). Hand-key duplicate.
crane2009is and Crane2009 are the same article (Is Perception a Propositional Attitude?, Phil Quarterly 59:236, same DOI). Zotero-style key vs hand key; only survivor is indexed.

cumming2013creatures (published, Analytic Philosophy 2013) and cumming2010creatures (2010 manuscript) share title 'Creatures of Darkness' and author. Manuscript-to-published pair of the same work; merge preserves the deep-indexed folder.

All three 'Discourse Content' by Cumming are versions of the same work: cumming2014discourse is the published Metasemantics chapter (DOI), cumming2009discourse and cumming2013discourse (note 'MS, UCLA', same DOI/pages) are earlier draft/manuscript states of it.
cumming2021showing (stub) and Cumming2020 (published Ergo article, DOI) share identical title, all four authors, and year 2021. Stub vs recovered published record of the same paper.
cumming2024attentional (stub manuscript) and Cumming2024 (unpublished, note 'Manuscript, February 2024') share title, author, year, and both are manuscripts. Same work.
cziko1995 and cziko1995without are identical books (Cziko, Without Miracles, MIT Press, same ISBN). Hand-key duplicate.
davidson1984inquiries and davidson1984donald are identical books (Davidson, Inquiries into Truth and Interpretation, Clarendon 1984, same ISBN). Hand-key duplicate.

All three 'Quotation, demonstration, and iconicity' by Kathryn Davidson: davidson2015quotation (published, DOI) and Davidson2015 (published duplicate) plus davidson2014quotation (2014 preprint manuscript). Preprint + published + duplicate of the same work.
davis2007how and Davis2007 are the same article (How normative is implicature, J. Pragmatics 39:10, same DOI). Hand key vs Zotero-style key; only survivor is indexed.

deacon1997symbolica and deacon1997symbolicb have identical title, authors (Unger reviewing Deacon), journal, volume, number, page 437, and DOI. Despite the a/b suffix these are byte-identical duplicate imports, not companion papers; neither is indexed.
